dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical narrowing of the lateral margins observed from the mid-thoracic region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with a slight asymmetrical bulge on the left mid-section relative to the right.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance across the primary dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse grey-pixel clusters localized along the right lateral margin and the neck region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the primary white baseline and localized grey-toned regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single high-contrast, dark circular aperture on the anterior dorsal midline.
